messages:
Eve: Quick heads-up 1 Lyra QBR scheduled Mon. Onboarding fine but we saw a 3x token spike overnight from their import job. Need: spend forecast, alert thresholds, enablement plan, and a short feedback capture. Can folks drop numbers by EOD?
Marco: I'll grab 30d and 7d burn + top endpoints. Early: embeds + vector-search are heavy. Will post numbers in 60m.
Lily: Ran a fast projection: baseline $7.6k/mo -> projected $22.4k/mo if import pattern repeats. Embeds ~68% of tokens. Recommend alerts at 70% and 90% of retainer.
Ken: I'll own enablement: 30min session on batching/prefix caching + a one-pager on scheduling bulk jobs to off-peak. Wed 10am PT OK for me.
Eve: What is their retainer? Need exact numbers for thresholds.
Marco: On file: $25k/month commit.
Lily: Using $25k -> 70% = $17.5k, 90% = $22.5k. Projected $22.4k is right at hard threshold. Recommend immediate soft alert at 17.5k and AE prep for renewal ask.
Marco: Quick numbers: `30d tokens: 2.0M; 7d tokens: 540k (avg 77k/day); embed calls/day +150% WoW; spike: /import-bulk 30k req in 3h (01:10-04:10 UTC)`.
alert-bot: billing: Lyra projection crossed 70% threshold -> notified @Lily @Eve
Ken: I'll draft the short survey for post-workshop: 3 Qs about latency vs cost, blockers to batching, interest in committed pricing.
Eve: Action items: Marco finalize CSV and logs; Lily draft alert email + thresholds; Ken prepare slides + survey; I'll assemble QBR deck. Target internal review Thu COB. Thanks.
